verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe creating a flag from the dashboard (Features > Create Feature, name it) and toggling it on or off per environment without deploying new code. SDKs in 15+ languages support wiring the flag into an app. Missing for 10: no evidence of signup or onboarding speed or time-to-first-flag (the 'within minutes' claim), no quickstart walkthrough evidence, and no independent or hands-on confirmation of the flow.
